name: CipherBench-PQC
description: The dataset for CipherBench-PQC: Quantifying Representation-Level Leakage of Post-Quantum Cryptographic Objects. Contents of pqc_dataset_v1.0.tar.gz (unpacks to cipherbench-pqc/): - Dataset: 34 classes x 300 objects = 10,200 objects (16 primitives + 18 containers), generated from FIPS 203/204/205 implementations (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and OpenSSL; CC BY 4.0.- Transfer set: 900-object cross-implementation test set (native OpenSSL 3.5, test-only).- Code (MIT): generator, training, evaluation and audit scripts.- Frozen results: per-seed / summary JSONs with environment fields and seed records.- Audit log: 51 numbered cases (Chinese / English). SHA-256 of the archive: 69fde5a58fb2a93b93661b4653bdc2e81b3d7458a73f2ffccb0bb02c452e6f7a Cryptographic objects draw fresh per-object keys from the system entropy source, so a regenerated dataset reproduces the same distribution, not the same bytes; this archive is the canonical dataset behind the paper's numbers.Evaluation protocol: 5-fold stratified CV x 5 seeds [7, 42, 99, 123, 2024]; the beta(G) ladder uses 50 Monte-Carlo draws, seed 2025. Reproduction steps and environment dependencies are documented in the companion code repository.
